preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of permutation n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for n, a in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the permutation a is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= a_i < n for a_i in a) for n, a in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, each element a_i in the permutation a is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(a)) == n for n, a in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the permutation a contains n distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result < 10**9 + 7 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and 10^9 + 6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == count_similar_permutations(n, a) % (10**9 + 7) for result, (n, a) in zip(results, zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(t)])))
postconditions.description: Each result is the number of permutations similar to the given permutation a, modulo 10^9 + 7.
